fact: On 15 July 2021 the Gabon and Cameroon ministers inaugurated the interconnection of their fibre networks (Gabon's BNG with CAMTEL's network) at Meyo-Kye under the CAB-4 project.
title: Interconnexion des réseaux de transmission numérique entre le Gabon et le Cameroun
publisher: Société de Patrimoine des Infrastructures Numériques
